title: EpisodeState
description: One row of the episode parquet — a single period observation within a debt-ceiling episode.

period.description: Simulation period index within the episode, starting at 0.

date.description: Calendar date corresponding to this period (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

days_to_xdate.description: Number of days remaining until the Treasury X-date at this period.

vix.description: CBOE Volatility Index level (positive real number).

tbill_4wk.description: 4-week Treasury bill yield in percent (positive real number).

market_stress_index.description: Composite market stress index, normalized to [0, 1].

polling_approval_pct.description: Presidential or congressional approval rating in percent.

debt_gdp_ratio.description: Federal debt as a percentage of GDP (positive real number).

deficit_projection_bn.description: Projected annual federal deficit in billions of USD.

election_days_out.description: Days until the next major federal election from t0.

condition_id.description: Experimental condition applied to this episode run (optional; added when a condition is overlaid).
